title: art/manifest.yaml asset entry
description: One entry under `assets:` (the key is the asset id: lowercase snake_case). Single source of truth: harness/art/assets.py validates against this file.

kind.description: What the asset is. Characters/enemies/npcs get animation checks.

stage.description: Production step reached. Maps to the lifecycle in docs/REFERENCE.md.

version.description: Bumped by `hx assets new-version`; approved versions are never overwritten.

picked.description: Concept file chosen by the director (never by an agent).

depends_on.description: Other asset ids this one needs (a rig for its animations, a kit for a prop).

animations.description: Clips delivered, named as in art/animation_spec.yaml.

outputs.description: Files delivered, relative to the repo root (e.g. game/Assets/Art/Models/hero/hero.fbx).

approved.description: Set only by `hx assets approve` (director). Locks `outputs` (sha256 in art/locks.json).
